_README: Hand-authored ANALYSIS specs (sub-step 3c). Each entry is one analysis — a comparison/finding OVER conditions (leaderboard, hypothesis test, sweep, ...). The generator (scripts/generate_post_run_report.py) validates these, attaches provenance, and emits results/analyses-manifest.json (+ .md). HYBRID authoring: the machine-fillable keys (analysis_id, type, conditions_compared, output_path) are authored here; the human-authored fields (outcome, hypothesis_refs, preregistered, deviations, predicted_outcome, tie_set, paper_section, working_notes_obs) may stay null until a human writes the finding + preregistration linkage, per the schema's lenient back-fill. Set manually_verified_at when a human has authored/verified a row. Schema: docs/manifest-schemas/analyses-manifest.schema.json.

analyses._note: The N=1 single-pass baseline leaderboard at 384px (the cross-architecture model x modality x thinking x temperature matrix). *** FINDING UNDER REVISION (2026-06-03, E57 genuine-Pro replace): the four anti-diagonal Pro corners were re-dispatched as genuine gemini-3.1-pro-preview (run n1-pro-rerun-384) after the n1-outstanding originals were found to have billed as Flash; conditions_compared now points at the genuine-Pro cells, REPLACING the Flash ones. tie_set / outcome / predicted_outcome are PENDING the tiering re-run (scripts/n1_baseline_leaderboard_tiering.py reads conditions_compared) and will be rewritten from results/paper-eval/n1/384px-14buf-mcc/tiering/tiering_20m.{json,md}. *** This single-pass board is the baseline comparator the consensus (H3) and proposer-verifier (H2) architectures are measured against. See docs/methodology/n1-baseline-matrix.md and planning/leaderboard-construction-plan.md.
